judgments.yea_description: Voted for Senate Bill 587, which changes how West Virginia governments buy construction work. It doubles the point at which a state agency, city, county or school board must seek competing bids, from $25,000 to $50,000. For projects of $20 million or more it creates a new track that picks a builder from a shortlist of at least three firms on an overall best-value score rather than the lowest bid. The Senate agreed to the House version 27-7 and it became law.
